description: A complete, deterministic pairing session (pairing-v1.md §14.1): inputs, intermediate values, the 7 frames, the decoded batch, N's TrustStore, a second session (replay), a relay that knows the code (P11) and the failure cases P9 to P17. Devices A, B, C are those of spec/vectors/v1/device.json (A invites, B is the new device, C is already a member).

mitm.description: P11: a relay that knows the code holds two sessions. It plays N towards A and A towards N. Its commitment (commit) is sent before it sees N's share: the two verification codes come from two independent ISKs, N's changes with N's yb, A's does not, and the commitment does not change.
